assumptions: Root cause (confirmed by reproduction on report-anchor.ts): the line-0 mapping came from the unbalanced-bracket fallback nearestRecordAbove, which started its 'last record' cursor at 0 (deliberately, so orphans read uncovered). The trusted grouping pass never produces 0; it parks owner-less lines as pending and drops them.

The lexer was lost on report-anchor.ts because stripComments (type-only.ts) reads the '//' inside the regex literal /^\.\// as a line comment, leaving an open paren. That trigger is filed separately as #1515 and left unchanged here (shared with the type-only detector; out of this item's surface).

A line with no recorded line at or above it in a lost pass is now left unattributed, so it stays not-coverable: the same representation (absent from the attribution map) the trusted pass already uses for a statement recorded nowhere.
Lines at and below the first record keep their nearest-record-above attribution unchanged (control test).
The PR #1406 canary:allow-untested fp suppression in report-anchor.ts existed only for this line-0 attribution, so it is removed.
